ast.scope: Lexical source projection; no macro expansion or semantic resolution

cost.scope: The scope-specific cost statement within the invariant-and-cost document; no runtime speed measurement inferred.

obernants.scope: A memory write excludes creation of the corresponding host probe in the selected isolation assertion. Failed script excludes exported file in CLI fixture. Unselected frozen parity functions supply no epoch runtime evidence.
Passing fixture assertions admits many implementations beyond exercised cases; captured output alone cannot recover filesystem effect trace, so tests also inspect paths/journal.
Selected host paths are synthetic temporary roots; guard cleanup occurs on unwind. Frozen SUITES constants and scenarios are unchanged and not executed.
Fixture setup unwraps and panics on filesystem failures; scratch removes prior same-PID/tag directory, so unique tags are part of safe test precondition. CLI output decodes lossily.
CLI helper returns status code or -1, stdout and stderr strings. No claim that empty stderr alone proves success; fixtures assert explicit code.
Bounded fixture cost plus interpreter and spawned CLI startup; no performance claim. Unselected suite loops would scale by scenario count and backend pairs.
